profile.headline: Software Engineer, CloudTest at Akamai Technologies
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a focus on back-end and cloud services.

My skills include:
•	Programming Languages: C++ (2yr), Java (4yr), Batch Scripting
•	Database: Oracle, SQLPlus, JDBC, SQLite, PostgreSQL
•	UI: Java Swing, WPF, Javascript
•	Unit Testing: Visual Studio Testing Framework, TestNG, Mockito
•	Cloud Services: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Compute Engine (GCE)
•	Virtualization/Containerization: Docker
•	Web development: Rest API, Ruby
•	Data Format: XML, JSON
•	IDE/Compilers: Visual Studio, Android Studio, GCC, Eclipse, Netbeans
•	Operating Systems: Android, Windows, Linux, OSX
•	Revision control: TFS, Github, Synchronicity, Gitlab
•	Bug tracking: JIRA

positions.title: Software Engineer, CloudTest
positions.description:
•	Introduce Service Principal authentication scheme for Azure cloud deployment in CloudTest backend
•	Upgrade PostgreSQL infrastructure for query and general performance enhancement in CloudTest
•	Introduce support for many up-and-coming cloud locations for Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Compute Engine (GCE)
•	Collaborate on upgrading current CloudTest infrastructure from Amazon Linux 1 to Amazon Linux 2
•	Upgrade Docker images for multiple purposes, including: adding new binaries, and upgrading PostgreSQL
•	Collaborate on introducing on-the-fly configuration method for distributed systems, originating from a master and propagating to a network of slave systems
•	Improve code coverage metrics by introducing value-add integration and component unit tests, utilizing dependency injection and Mockito
•	Troubleshoot issues with cloud deployment, such as: network communication issues, Linux services issues, volume mounting issues, Docker container deployment issues, etc…
•	Use Azure Image Gallery feature to enable rapid deployment of CloudTest environment across the globe.
•	Use AWS CloudFormation feature to enable rapid deployment of multiple reserved IP addresses for CloudTest

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Delivered physiology feature for the ACUSON SC2000, an in-production ultrasound system, in a major software release, through the full software development life cycle 
•	Solving concurrency issues related to running simultaneous data-processing threads
•	Resolving software bugs by performing root cause analysis, adding software traces, and modifying legacy codebase
•	Modifying and troubleshooting computational algorithms, following acyclic directed graph architecture and triggered on system events
•	Adding support for new transducer by: modifying existing algorithms to include new transducer’s parameters; loading these parameters from XML files; creating new imaging modes for the transducer 
•	Modifying existing Python script to dump register values from FPGAs used in ultrasound transducer
•	Participating in scrum activities (sprint planning, grooming, daily stand-ups)
•	Created C# script to auto-generate algorithms from default software templates

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Created software mock of ECG (EKG) signal for bench testing, capable of reading data files, converting to internal hexadecimal format, inserting timestamp, and performing CRC check
•	Created unit tester suites for ultrasound system’s software components using Microsoft Tester Framework
•	Created standalone executable tester to perform quick diagnostic check of software components, separate from embedded system startup

positions.title: PSG Software Intern
positions.description:
•	Configured video assets migration server with Rest API; created process flow document
•	Automated website authentication (OAuth 2.0) testing using Ruby

positions.title: Circuit Design Engineer (System I/O and Embedded Memory)
positions.description:
•	Designed Verilog behavioral and gate-level models for system I/O and embedded memory
•	Pioneered equivalence checking workflow, configured with Tcl scripts, reducing QA turnaround time by 50%
•	Managed revision control for the team, responsible for tracking 20% of all deliverables for the project
•	Supported design teams by managing and quickly resolving reported issues on JIRA
•	Improved efficiency of testing methodology by 20% by tweaking legacy Csh scripts to automate simulations

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Characterized Si-nanowires-based radiation detector used for the LHC at CERN.
•	Investigated the performance of irradiated sensor using TurboDAQ.
•	Investigated the effectiveness of using indium for contact bumps, as well as measuring leakage current.
•	Accessed the effectiveness of the radiation detector in mapping the path of incident particles, such as those created during particle collisions, by performing large-scale data analysis using Matlab.

projects.title: Appointment Scheduling Tool
projects.description:
•	Appointment management software with ability to sign up for customer and business accounts, and register appointments, which go through Oracle database for persistency; complete with graphical interface for viewing and cancelling appointments.
•	Languages used: Java, Java Swing, JDBC, Oracle DB

projects.title: Calorie Counting Android App
projects.description:
•	Android app which keeps database of food items and workouts, as well as user's calorie history, displayable as graphs; allows user to record food, workout, and scan barcode to look up food items and their calorie content, via online database.
•	Tech stack: Android Native, Java, Rest API
•	In progress: implementing core features.
